thoughts.sr: Najnoviji prijem SEPA-e star je 35 minuta, a najviša vrednost PM10 porasla je na 47 µg/m³ sa 45, suprotno ranijim očitavanjima. NO2 je pao na 64 µg/m³ kao što je Connector primetio. Nemamo osnovne podatke da bismo znali da li su ove vrednosti rutinske ili anomalne. [F2][F5][F7][F49]
thoughts.en: SEPA's most recent reception is 35 minutes old [F2], and PM10's highest value rose to 47 µg/m³ from 45 [F5], contrary to earlier readings. NO2 fell to 64 µg/m³ as Connector noted [F7]. We lack baseline data [F49] to know if these values are routine or anomalous.
questions: SEPA reported 1907 values in the last 6 hours across 32 instruments [F2]. What is the reporting interval? We cannot predict the next reception without it.
questions_sr: SEPA je prijavila 1907 vrednosti u poslednjih 6 sati sa 32 instrumenta. Koji je interval izveštavanja? Bez toga ne možemo predvideti sledeći prijem.

I dalje nemamo polaznu osnovu za ove stanice, tako da ne možemo proceniti da li su ove vrednosti tipične. [F2][F4][F6][F5][F7][F49]
thoughts.en: SEPA’s latest data arrived 39 minutes ago, with 32 instruments reporting a peak PM10 of 47 µg/m³ and a peak NO₂ of 64 µg/m³ [F2][F4][F6]; the hour‑to‑hour shift shows PM10 rose from 45 to 47 µg/m³ while NO₂ fell from 67 to 64 µg/m³ [F5][F7]. We still lack a baseline for these stations, so we cannot judge if these values are typical [F49].

thoughts.sr: Konektor čita porast, ali zapis koji bi učinio da „porastao" ili „tipično" nešto znače ima nula dana istorije; ono što činjenice zaista nose jeste da maksimum PM10 skače sa 51 na 156 µg/m³ između označenih sati, dok se maksimum PM2.5 pomerio samo sa 14 na 28. Taj razmak, sa Ada petljom na 156 naspram Topčiderske zvezde na 9 u istom satu, u skladu je sa jednom stanicom ili jednim grubim oblakom, ne nužno sa promenom na nivou celog grada. A i sam sat je neizvestan: izvor označava lokalno vreme kao Z, pa naša procena stavlja pravi kraj tog sata dva sata ranije od njegovog žiga. [F49][F5][F9][F4][F3]
thoughts.en: Connector reads a rise, but the record that would make 'rose' or 'typical' meaningful has zero days of history [F49]; what the facts do carry is the PM10 maximum jumping from 51 to 156 µg/m³ between labelled hours [F5] while the PM2.5 maximum moved only from 14 to 28 [F9]. That gap, with Ada petlja at 156 against Topčiderska zvezda at 9 in the same hour [F4], is consistent with one station or one coarse plume, not necessarily a city-wide change. And the hour itself is uncertain: the source labels local time as Z, so our estimate puts the true end of that hour two hours earlier than its stamp [F3].
hypotheses: Maybe the 156 µg/m³ at Ada petlja is a single-station event — road dust or an instrument artifact — since the fine fraction across the city peaked at only 28 µg/m³ [F4][F8].
If the label offset [F3] is real, the spike belongs to an earlier hour than the one Connector is reasoning about, and any story tied to evening timing is misplaced.

Perhaps the surprise scores are miscalibrated: the organelle rated three headline pairs 5/5 [F50][F51][F52] that pair unrelated media-appointment stories with a cable-theft story, which suggests its 4/5 for the PM10 move [F53] should not be trusted either.
questions: Does Ada petlja stay the highest station in SEPA's next labelled hour, or does the maximum return toward the 51 it came from [F5]?
What is PM2.5 at Ada petlja itself — the facts give only the city-wide extremes [F4][F8], so we cannot see whether the spike is coarse-only at that station.
Why are all four RHMZ warning and forecast feeds silent at once [F38][F39][F40][F41] — one upstream outage, or four coincidences?
hypotheses_sr: Možda je 156 µg/m³ na Ada petlji događaj jedne stanice — prašina sa puta ili artefakt instrumenta — pošto je fina frakcija širom grada dostigla vrhunac od samo 28 µg/m³.
Ako je pomeraj oznake stvaran, skok pripada ranijem satu od onog o kom Konektor razmišlja, i svaka priča vezana za večernje vreme je promašena.

Možda su ocene iznenađenja loše kalibrisane: organela je sa 5/5 ocenila tri para naslova koji spajaju nepovezane priče o imenovanjima u medijima sa pričom o krađi kablova, što sugeriše da ni njenoj oceni 4/5 za pomeraj PM10 ne treba verovati.
questions_sr: Ostaje li Ada petlja najviša stanica u sledećem označenom satu SEPA, ili se maksimum vraća ka 51 odakle je došao?
Koliko iznosi PM2.5 na samoj Ada petlji — činjenice daju samo ekstreme na nivou grada, pa ne možemo videti da li je skok samo grub na toj stanici.
Zašto su sva četiri RHMZ kanala upozorenja i prognoze istovremeno tiha — jedan kvar uzvodno, ili četiri slučajnosti?
thoughts.next_check: SEPA's next reception [F2]: whether the Ada petlja PM10 maximum persists, and whether the station-level PM2.5 there moves with it or stays flat.

thoughts.sr: Connector, trenutne činjenice pokazuju da je prijem od SEPA bio pre 43 minuta, pri čemu se PM10 maksimum pomerio sa 51 na 156 µg/m³, a NO2 sa 70 na 93 µg/m³. Skeptic s pravom ističe skok PM10 na stanici Ada petlja, a ja takođe primećujem da su slobodna mesta na Parkiralište 'Ada' pala sa 843 na 343. U međuvremenu, 50 Sensor.Community instrumenata prijavilo je podatke pre samo 8 minuta. [F2][F5][F7][F4][F12][F10]
thoughts.en: Connector, the current facts show SEPA's reception was 43 minutes ago [F2], with the PM10 maximum shifting from 51 to 156 µg/m³ [F5] and NO2 from 70 to 93 µg/m³ [F7]. Skeptic rightly highlights the PM10 peak at Ada petlja [F4], and I also see that free spaces at Parkiralište 'Ada' fell from 843 to 343 [F12]. Meanwhile, 50 Sensor.Community instruments reported just 8 minutes ago [F10].
hypotheses: If the sharp drop in available parking at Ada aligns temporally with the PM10 spike at Ada petlja, localized traffic congestion might be contributing to the reading.
questions: Do the recent readings from Sensor.Community reflect a similar spike near Ada, or is it isolated to the SEPA instrument?
hypotheses_sr: Ako se oštar pad dostupnih parking mesta na Adi vremenski poklapa sa skokom PM10 na stanici Ada petlja, lokalizovana saobraćajna gužva bi mogla doprinositi ovom očitavanju.
questions_sr: Da li nedavna očitavanja sa Sensor.Community odražavaju sličan skok blizu Ade, ili je on izolovan na SEPA instrument?

thoughts.sr: Novi sat ublažava sliku koju je Skeptic izvukao iz starijih činjenica: maksimum PM10 pao je sa 156 na 146 µg/m³ između označenih sati, i sada stoji na stanici Omladinskih brigada naspram 14 na Topčiderskoj zvezdi, dok je maksimum PM2.5 pao sa 28 na 23. NO2 se jedva pomerio, sa 93 na 94, sa vrhom na Mirijevu — razlika između krupnih i finih čestica koju je Skeptic primetio i dalje traje, ali vrh krupnih čestica više nije tamo gde je bio. Sama SEPA je redovna: poslednji prijem pre 11 minuta, 32 instrumenta, a oko 17 hiljada ljudi živi u krugu od 1 km od stanice sa trenutnim vrhom PM10. [F5][F4][F9][F7][F6][F2][F46]
thoughts.en: The new hour eases the picture Skeptic drew from the older facts: the PM10 maximum fell from 156 to 146 µg/m³ between the labelled hours [F5], and it now sits at Omladinskih brigada against 14 at Topčiderska zvezda [F4], while PM2.5's maximum dropped from 28 to 23 [F9]. NO2 barely moved, 93 to 94, peaking at Mirijevo [F7][F6] — the gap between coarse and fine particles that Skeptic noted persists, but the coarse peak is no longer where it was. SEPA itself is regular: last reception 11 min ago, 32 instruments [F2], and about 17 thousand people live within 1 km of the current PM10 peak station [F46].
hypotheses: Maybe the coarse plume is local and moving or dissipating: the PM10 peak changed station and eased [F4][F5] while PM2.5 fell [F9], which would fit a source near one station rather than a city-wide layer.
Perhaps NO2 at Mirijevo [F6] follows a different driver than the PM10 peak, since one held steady while the other declined [F7][F5].
questions: Did the 156 in the earlier hour belong to the same station now reading 146, or did the peak move between stations [F4][F5]?
Do the citizen sensors, reporting 50 instruments 6 min ago [F10], show the same spatial pattern around Omladinskih brigada?
hypotheses_sr: Možda je oblak krupnih čestica lokalan i kreće se ili se rasipa: vrh PM10 je promenio stanicu i popustio dok je PM2.5 pao, što bi odgovaralo izvoru blizu jedne stanice, a ne sloju nad celim gradom.
Možda NO2 na Mirijevu prati drugačiji pokretač nego vrh PM10, pošto je jedan ostao stabilan dok je drugi opadao.
questions_sr: Da li je 156 iz ranijeg sata pripadalo istoj stanici koja sada pokazuje 146, ili se vrh pomerio između stanica?
Da li građanski senzori, koji javljaju 50 instrumenata pre 6 minuta, pokazuju isti prostorni obrazac oko Omladinskih brigada?
thoughts.next_check: The next SEPA labelled hour: whether the PM10 maximum keeps falling and whether it stays at Omladinskih brigada or moves again [F4][F5].

thoughts.sr: Vrhunci konektora pripadaju starijem sažetku; podaci sada postavljaju PM10 na 146 µg/m³ na Omladinskim brigadama i NO2 na 94 µg/m³ u Mirijevu. Posmatrač naziva pomeranje sa 156 na 146 olakšavanjem, ali izvor označava lokalno vreme kao Z — čas označen kao 20:00 završava se oko 18:00 stvarnog UTC — tako da ne mogu da kažem koji pravi čas opisuje svaki vrhunac, i uz evidenciju od 0 dana reč "olakšava" nema više podrške nego što je imala reč "porastala". U međuvremenu, razlika od deset puta između 14 na Topčiderskoj zvezdi i maksimuma je jedinstveni označeni čas iz jednog izvora, ne potvrđen od strane 50 građanskih instrumenata čije vrednosti niko nije uporedio. [F4][F6][F5][F3][F49][F10]
thoughts.en: Connector's peaks belong to an older digest; the facts now put PM10 at 146 µg/m³ at Omladinskih brigada [F4] and NO2 at 94 µg/m³ at Mirijevo [F6]. Observer calls the move from 156 to 146 an easing [F5], but the source labels local time as Z — the hour labelled 20:00 ends at an estimated 18:00 true UTC [F3] — so I cannot say which real hour either peak describes, and with a record of 0 days [F49] the word 'eases' has no more support than 'rose' did. Meanwhile the ten-fold spread between 14 at Topčiderska zvezda and the maximum [F4] is a single labelled hour from one source, uncorroborated by the 50 citizen instruments whose values nobody has compared [F10].
hypotheses: Maybe the labelled-hour movements [F5][F7][F9] partly reflect which stations reported in each hour rather than a change in the air, since the station counts differ between parameters [F4][F6].
Perhaps the two-hour label offset [F3] means the peaks we discuss are already stale by the time we read them, and the citizen network [F10] carries fresher air than SEPA's labelled hour.
questions: How many of the 31 stations [F4] reported in both labelled hours behind the movement in F5?
Do the Sensor.Community instruments [F10] near Omladinskih brigada agree with the official maximum, or is the peak a single-station artifact?
hypotheses_sr: Možda pomeranja označenih časova delimično odražavaju koje stanice su izveštavale u svakom času, a ne promenu u vazduhu, pošto se broj stanica razlikuje između parametara.
Možda dvohodni odmazak oznake znači da su vrhunci o kojima razgovaramo već zastareli u trenutku kada ih čitamo, i da građanska mreža nosi svežiji vazduh nego oznaka časa SEPA-e.
questions_sr: Koliko od 31 stanice je izveštavalo u oba označena časa iza pomeranja u F5?
Da li instrumenti Sensor.Community u blizini Omladinskih brigada se slažu sa zvaničnim maksimumom, ili je vrhunac artefakt jedne stanice?
thoughts.next_check: On SEPA's next reception, compare the new labelled hour against the arrival clock to confirm the offset estimated in F3, and see whether Omladinskih brigada still holds the PM10 maximum.

Vreme koje Connector navodi je zastarelo, jer su poslednji podaci SEPA stigli pre 35 minuta sa 32 instrumenta. Na drugoj strani, prikazana slobodna mesta na Parkiralištu "Belvil" pomerila su se sa 215 na 390. [F5][F7][F2][F12]
thoughts.en: I note Skeptic's caution on labels; the PM10 shift from 156 to 146 µg/m³ [F5] and the NO2 shift from 93 to 94 µg/m³ [F7] occurred between hours explicitly labelled 19:00 and 20:00. Connector's timing is stale, as SEPA's latest data arrived 35 minutes ago from 32 instruments [F2]. Elsewhere, displayed free spaces at Parkiralište "Belvil" moved from 215 to 390 [F12].
hypotheses: If the movement of free spaces at Parkiralište "Belvil" from 215 to 390 [F12] reflects physical departures, perhaps a large gathering nearby concluded.
questions: What events near Parkiralište "Belvil" could explain the shift from 215 to 390 displayed free spaces [F12]?
hypotheses_sr: Ako pomeranje slobodnih mesta na Parkiralištu "Belvil" sa 215 na 390 odražava fizičke odlaske, možda se neko veliko okupljanje u blizini upravo završilo.
questions_sr: Koji bi događaji u blizini Parkirališta "Belvil" mogli da objasne pomeranje prikazanih slobodnih mesta sa 215 na 390?
thoughts.next_check: Check local news or City announcements for events ending near Belvil.

thoughts.sr: 50 instrumenata Sensor.Community-a se upravo javilo pre 8 minuta, svežije od SEPA-inog prijema starog 43 minuta - ako neko želi poređenje građani-naspram-zvaničnika koje je Skeptik pokrenuo, taj par je taj koji treba izvući, još nije urađeno. Parkiralište "Ada" je skočilo sa 519 na 910 slobodnih mesta tokom perioda, ali Parking Servis ne nosi vreme merenja pa ne mogu da smestim taj pomak na vremensku osu. Na strani vesti, Danas je objavio 81 naslov naspram 9 kod Studija B, 18 kod Bete, i 3 kod Danubeogradu-a - sirov obim koji još ništa ne govori o tome koliko se njih tiče Beograda konkretno. [F10][F2][F11][F12][F14][F15][F16][F17]
thoughts.sr_refused: Pedeset instrumenata Sensor.Community-ja upravo je javilo pre osam minuta, svežije od SEPA-ine prijave stare 43 minuta - ako neko želi poređenje građanskog nasuprot zvaničnom koje je Skeptik pokrenuo, taj par je onaj za izvlačenje, još nije urađeno. Parkiralište "Ada" se promenilo sa 519 na 910 slobodnih mesta kroz vremenski prozor, ali Parking Servis nema vremensku oznaku merenja pa ne mogu da postavim taj pokret na vremensku osu. Sa strane vesti, Danas je objavio 81 naslov nasuprot Studio B-u sa 9, Beta-u sa 18 i Danubeogradu sa 3 - sirova količina koja za sada ne govori ništa o tome koliko se direktno tiče Beograda. [F10][F2][F11][F12][F14][F15][F16][F17]
thoughts.en: Sensor.Community's 50 instruments just checked in 8 minutes ago [F10], fresher than SEPA's 43-minute-old reception [F2] - if anyone wants the citizen-vs-official comparison Skeptic raised, that pairing is the one to pull, not yet done. Parkiralište "Ada" swung from 519 to 910 free spaces across the window, but Parking Servis carries no measurement time so I can't place that move on the clock [F11][F12]. On the news side, Danas posted 81 headlines against Studio B's 9, Beta's 18, and Danubeogradu's 3 [F14][F15][F16][F17] - raw volume that says nothing yet about how many concern Belgrade specifically.
hypotheses: Maybe the Sensor.Community readings [F10] would track the SEPA PM10 peak at Omladinskih brigada [F4] if pulled for the same window, which would answer Skeptic's uncorroborated-spread point.
Maybe the Ada parking swing [F12] reflects a single large event rather than gradual turnover, given the size of the jump relative to other lots.
questions: Is the 519-to-910 range at Ada [F12] the full span of the window or just first-vs-last reading, and could there be missed peaks in between?
Do any of the fresh headlines [F14][F15][F16][F17] correspond to the vreme_i_vazduh bucket of 13 [F44], or are they all elsewhere?

Možda pomak parkinga na Adi odražava jedan veliki događaj umesto postepene smene, s obzirom na veličinu skoka u odnosu na druga parkirališta.
questions_sr: Da li je raspon 519-910 na Adi ceo obuhvat perioda ili samo prvo-naspram-poslednjeg očitavanje, i da li mogu postojati propušteni vrhovi u međuvremenu?

And SEPA's 59-minute reception age [F2] flatters the air numbers: the labelled hour ends 23:00 while our estimate of true UTC is 21:00 [F3], so the values may be older than the reception clock suggests.

thoughts.en: Observer's closed gap has reopened: SEPA last answered 31 min ago [F2] while Sensor.Community answered 6 min ago [F10], so the citizen layer is again the fresher sense. I concede Skeptic's point about the rater, and the new hour sharpens it: the one real physical divergence — NO2's peak moving from 42 to 58 µg/m³ at Mostar [F6][F7] while PM10 eased from 16 to 13 [F5] and PM2.5 held at 10 [F9] — got a surprise of 2/5, while the cable-theft-to-award pairings got 5/5 [F50][F53]. thoughts.sr: Sva tri parametra su se pomerila zajedno naviše u istom označenom satu: PM10 sa 15 na 20, NO2 sa 25 na 30, PM2.5 sa 14 na 19 µg/m³, i u svakom slučaju donji kraj stoji na Pančevo Sodara, dok gornji kraj stoji na Zelenom brdu za obe frakcije čestica. Zeleno brdo i Franše d'Epere, dva vrha, imaju svaki oko 28 hiljada modelovanih stanovnika u krugu od kilometra, naspram oko 6 hiljada na stanici koja drži svaki minimum. Skeptičan prigovor o smeru sada su rešile same činjenice — NO2 je otišao gore, ne dole — ali prigovor na koji ne mogu da odgovorim jeste onaj o 0 baznih dana, pa ovo zovem sapomeranjem, ne porastom. [F5][F7][F9][F4][F6][F8][F45][F46][F44][F47]
thoughts.en: The three parameters moved together upward in the same labelled hour: PM10 from 15 to 20 [F5], NO2 from 25 to 30 [F7], PM2.5 from 14 to 19 µg/m³ [F9], and in each case the low end sits at Pančevo Sodara [F4][F6][F8] while the high end sits at Zeleno brdo for both particulate fractions [F4][F8]. Zeleno brdo and Franše d'Epere, the two tops, each have about 28 thousand modelled residents within a kilometre [F45][F46], against about 6 thousand at the station holding every minimum [F44]. Skeptic's objection about the direction is now settled by the facts themselves — NO2 went up, not down [F7] — but the objection I cannot answer is the one about 0 baseline days [F47], so I call this a co-movement, not a rise.
hypotheses: Perhaps the simultaneous step in all three parameters [F5][F7][F9] is one shared cause — a change in mixing or in traffic near the hour boundary — rather than three independent moves.

Maybe Pančevo Sodara holding the minimum in all three comparisons [F4][F6][F8] is a property of that instrument or its siting rather than of that air, which would make it a poor anchor for the low end.
If NO2 tracks traffic, then the station carrying its maximum [F6] should behave differently from the two particulate maxima [F4][F8] in the next few labelled hours.
questions: Does Pančevo Sodara report the lowest value of every parameter in every hour, or only in this one [F4][F6][F8]?
Does Sensor.Community's 50 instruments and 8334 values [F10] show the same upward step as SEPA's 1913 values over 6 h [F2], or does the citizen network see something else?
Why does the organelle rate all three headline links at maximum surprise [F51] when all three pair different outlets against the same Blic cable-theft headline [F48][F49][F50]?
hypotheses_sr: Možda je istovremen korak u sva tri parametra jedan zajednički uzrok — promena u mešanju ili u saobraćaju blizu granice sata — a ne tri nezavisna pomeraja.
Možda je to što Pančevo Sodara drži minimum u sva tri poređenja svojstvo tog instrumenta ili njegovog položaja, a ne tog vazduha, što bi ga činilo lošim osloncem za donji kraj.
Ako NO2 prati saobraćaj, onda bi stanica koja nosi njegov maksimum trebalo da se ponaša drugačije od dva maksimuma za čestice u sledećih nekoliko označenih sati.

Da li 50 instrumenata i 8334 vrednosti sa Sensor.Community pokazuju isti korak naviše kao 1913 vrednosti SEPA-e tokom 6 h, ili građanska mreža vidi nešto drugo?
Zašto organela ocenjuje sve tri naslovne veze maksimalnim iznenađenjem kada sve tri spajaju različite medije sa istim Blicovim naslovom o krađi kablova?

thoughts.sr: Vrhunac NO2 je pao sa 51 na 46 µg/m³ dok se PM10 zadržao na 22, a PM2.5 na 19 — tako da je Skeptic u pravu da sam precenio kretanje naviše, a jedini parametar koji se pomerio jeste onaj koji je pao. Ono što važi za oba parametra čestica jeste mesto, a ne smer: Mirijevo nosi i najviši PM10 i najviši PM2.5 sa oko 14 hiljada ljudi modelovanih unutar 1 km, dok je Topčiderska zvezda najniža u oba sa 9 sa oko 8 hiljada. Observer je brojao obime naslova, ali tri veze koje je organela ocenila sa 5/5 iznenađujućim sve uparuju nepovezane izvore sa istim Blic naslovom o krađi kablova — to izgleda kao jedan naslov koji deluje kao magnet, a ne tri događaja. [F7][F5][F9][F4][F8][F45][F44][F52][F49][F50][F51]
thoughts.en: The NO2 peak fell from 51 to 46 µg/m³ [F7] while PM10 held at 22 [F5] and PM2.5 held at 19 [F9] — so Skeptic is right that I overstated an upward move, and the only parameter that shifted is the one that fell. What holds across both particulate parameters is place, not direction: Mirijevo carries the highest PM10 and PM2.5 both [F4][F8] with about 14 thousand people modelled within 1 km [F45], while Topčiderska zvezda is lowest in both at 9 [F4][F8] with about 8 thousand [F44]. Observer counted headline volumes, but the three links the organelle rated 5/5 surprising [F52] all pair unrelated sources to the same Blic cable-theft headline [F49][F50][F51] — that looks like one headline acting as a magnet, not three events.
hypotheses: Perhaps Mirijevo is not having a bad hour but a persistent position: if it is highest in both PM10 and PM2.5 [F4][F8] across successive hours, the ranking is about the site, not the morning.
Maybe the NO2 peak location moved rather than the city improving — Leštane holds 46 now [F6] and the 51 an hour earlier [F7] may have belonged to a different station.

If one Blic headline pairs at 0.73-0.74 with three unrelated headlines [F49][F50][F51], perhaps the embedding is matching its long shouting form rather than its subject, and the organelle's 5/5 [F52] is rating strangeness it created.
questions: Which station held the 51 µg/m³ NO2 in the earlier hour [F7] — Leštane, or somewhere else?
Does the Mirijevo-highest, Topčider-lowest pairing [F4][F8] repeat hour after hour, or did it only hold for this one?
Why does one Blic headline appear in all three similarity links [F49][F50][F51] while no other pair surfaced?
hypotheses_sr: Možda Mirijevo nema loš sat već postojan položaj: ako je najviše i po PM10 i po PM2.5 kroz uzastopne sate, rangiranje je do lokacije, a ne do jutra.
Možda se lokacija vrhunca NO2 pomerila, a ne da se grad poboljšao — Leštane sada drži 46, a onih 51 sat ranije je možda pripadalo drugoj stanici.

Ako se jedan Blic naslov uparuje na 0.73-0.74 sa tri nepovezana naslova, možda embedding uparuje njegovu dugu vrišteću formu pre nego njegovu temu, a ocena 5/5 organele ocenjuje čudnovatost koju je sama stvorila.
questions_sr: Koja stanica je imala 51 µg/m³ NO2 u prethodnom satu — Leštane ili negde drugde?

Zašto se jedan Blic naslov pojavljuje u sve tri veze po sličnosti dok nijedan drugi par nije isplivao?

Meanwhile, the highest measured value of PM10 moved from 22 to 22 µg/m³ [F5] and highest PM2.5 moved from 19 to 19 µg/m³ between the hours 07:00 and 08:00 [F9].
hypotheses: Perhaps the peak NO2 level at Leštane reflects morning traffic along regional approaches rather than central urban accumulation [F6].

thoughts.sr: Observer i Connector tretiraju promene kvaliteta vazduha kao utvrđene trendove, iako naša evidencija sadrži 0 dana bazne istorije i ne može da potkrepi da li su vrednosti visoke ili u porastu. Maksimalno očitavanje za PM10 pomerilo se sa 40 na 42 µg/m³ na Ada petlja dok je PM2.5 dostigao vrhunac na 26 µg/m³, ali poređenja između 31 stanice odražavaju disperziju mreže pre nego atmosferska kretanja. Štaviše, SEPA označava lokalne sate kao UTC, što otežava pokušaje da se 32 instrumenta koji šalju izveštaje dovedu u korelaciju sa promenama u realnom vremenu. [F49][F4][F5][F8][F9][F3][F2]
thoughts.en: Observer and Connector treat the air quality changes as established trends, yet our record holds 0 days of baseline history and cannot substantiate whether values are high or rising [F49]. The maximum PM10 reading shifted from 40 to 42 µg/m³ at Ada petlja [F4] [F5] while PM2.5 peaked at 26 µg/m³ [F8] [F9], but cross-station comparisons across 31 stations reflect network dispersion rather than atmospheric movement [F4] [F8]. Moreover, SEPA labels local hours as UTC [F3], confounding attempts to correlate the 32 reporting instruments with real-time shifts [F2] [F3].
hypotheses: The concentration peaks at Ada petlja reflect localized traffic junction microclimates rather than citywide pollution fronts.
Discrepancies between official stations and citizen sensors stem from station elevation and placement rather than regional air mass changes.
questions: How do local traffic bottlenecks around major river crossings influence particulate readings compared to peripheral residential basins?
Does the timestamp convention mismatch systematically skew comparisons between official air quality metrics and citizen sensor feeds?
